description:
Outcome: Coordinator has trustworthy season, household and returner records (brief.md: Background, Rules, Constraints).
Scope: Household identity separate from email login, controlled coordinator provisioning, duplicate-household reconciliation, 40 plots and labels, season dates/timezone, prior-season entry, database integrity and audit. Excludes: bulk historical import and public contact directory.
Acceptance: Coordinator prepares coming season and previous holders; household/plot allocations unique per season; invalid dates and duplicate history refused. Reconciliation preserves history and original application order. Only coordinator accesses gardener contact details.
Behaviour: Atomic reconciliation; clear conflicts and missing-history states; unauthorized access denied.
Verification: PostgreSQL constraints, date boundaries, reconciliation and role tests. Prerequisites: T-001. Assumptions: coordinator supplies paper records/plot layout and timezone; one email login represents household but email alone does not prove unique household; dates default March 1–October 31, editable within March–October.
title: Configure households, 40 plots, seasons and prior allocations
